canonical_owner_policy: Reference and decode existing canonical owner records. New outer adapter bindings are proposed; no duplicate canonical class/schema or new native enum value is introduced.

identity_layers.name: raw_source
identity_layers.meaning: raw CID over exact bytes; content SHA256 is separately a diagnostic/exposure identity

identity_layers.name: native_transition_identity
identity_layers.meaning: CID excludes the native claimed CID field

identity_layers.name: pinned_transport
identity_layers.meaning: CID/digest over complete canonical serialized record, including its native claimed CID; differs from native identity CID

identity_layers.name: target_envelope_digest
identity_layers.meaning: hash over target_schema, source_binding and authored_contracts; not raw source SHA

identity_layers.name: vector_input_profile
identity_layers.meaning: complete source/span/context/encoder/tokenizer/assets/numerical profile, not either source digest alone

proposed_outer_envelope.unknown_fields_policy: closed versioned decoder rejects unknown fields; expected outcomes do not enter runtime results
proposed_outer_envelope.cell_routing: exact cell/store/incarnation/version envelope; native subject/source/logic identity retains canonical owner semantics

interfaces.name: capture and policy observation
proposed_guards: exact expected durable head
live admitted source bytes and active ASTs
source-mode and ignore policy
complete nonexcluded inventory accounting
reobservation after operation replay

interfaces.name: conditional receipt and attempt routing
proposed_guards: source/contract/compilation/head/assumptions/bounds/checker exact binding
only proved/refuted in current historical index
fresh native checks for current use
conditional authority preserved
nonterminal and raised failures in separate attempt journal/owner extension

interfaces.name: bounded native transition and transport
proposed_guards: repair query has authentic current_graph_cid
candidate restricted to admitted query universe
native repair enum unchanged
decode/recompute native identity separate from full-record transport identity
raw Python source CID never used as JSON PinnedArtifactRef
prediction cannot decode as observation

interfaces.name: read-only state-qualified intent grounding
proposed_guards: separate current versus planned-post semantic subject
predicate_id alone never separates states
keep H0 false conditional claim within exact declared scope
typed root/cell/role/incarnation and source/applicability bindings
current structural observations distinct from universal runtime behavior
no automatic promotion of conditional_smt into authoritative ProofReceipt/ObservedFact
unknown facts preserve review/observation workflow

interfaces.name: reviewed producer and runner binding
proposed_guards: actual runner/tool/args/allowed paths/checks/effects/leases/budgets
nonempty producer effects and task closures
required policies and evidence independently admitted
fallback marker cannot execute a check
no effects in first milestone

interfaces.name: measured successor and post-state verification
proposed_guards: query H0 subject retained in observation
H1 in observed_cid and measured mapping
new H1 verification plan and post-state graph
fresh pre/post source/environment observations
P-to-C1 mapping and receipt keys agree with new plan
conditional result not automatically authoritative ProofReceipt
affected tests remain separate TestReceipt
mutation/completion/equivalence flags in native transition admission remain false

interfaces.name: inherited model branch admission
proposed_guards: actual parent bytes and role/task/profile/codec
registered cohort and frozen evaluation roles
unknown critical atoms trigger basis migration
original-root replay and intermediate exposure history separate
exact vector profile identity
source384 two-operand scope
existing multilingual corpus domain allow-list excludes codebase_ir
structural embedding receipt completeness cannot assert verified production/tokenization

exact H1 source/native contract and translated obligation
actual admitted Z3/CVC5 profile with measured environment/roots
separate executed test receipt on H1
H1 graph and P-to-C1 completion mapping; current evidence eligibility

implementation_slices.description: Authenticate clean integrated source/model owners and create isolated fixture scope
Capture/reobserve exact source and complete bounded inventory
Execute conditional native checks and route terminal/nonterminal attempts
Register typed formalization and read-only current/planned-post grounding
Register reviewed producer/runner/observer and post-state mapping contracts
Witness effectful H0-to-H1 change with new plan/graph/evidence
Qualify inherited corpus/basis migration and independent evaluation
Run private compatible adaptation under frozen profile and retention gates
